name: Dentrix Ascend
description: Dentrix Ascend is a cloud dental-practice management platform for scheduling, patient communication, charting, imaging, treatment planning, eligibility, claims, billing, payments, analytics, and multi-location operations. Henry Schein One exposes integrations through its approved API Exchange.
agentUseSummary: Dentrix Ascend is visible as an API Exchange-review preview only. Relay will not collect a Dentrix Ascend login, OAuth token, client secret, organization or patient identifier, chart, treatment plan, insurance detail, payment detail, or other credential, and no agent action is callable until Henry Schein One and Relay's healthcare owners approve the exact bounded read-only contract.

capabilities.label: Read approved Dentrix Ascend practice summaries
capabilities.description: After Henry Schein One and Relay's healthcare owners approve the integration, read only bounded appointment, provider, location, and minimized patient-summary data for one exact organization and explicitly approved fields.

blocked.label: Connect before API Exchange approval
blocked.description: Henry Schein One requires vendor application, commercial and security review, setup, testing, SOC 2 Type II and OAuth 2.0 certification, and practice authorization. Relay has none of those approvals or a registered production integration.

blocked.label: Collect clinical or application credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask for a Dentrix Ascend login, OAuth token, client secret, organization or patient identifier, chart, treatment plan, insurance detail, payment detail, or other secret as a substitute for an approved API Exchange connection.

blocked.label: Run Dentrix Ascend API actions
blocked.description: No patient, appointment, chart, imaging, treatment, prescription, insurance, eligibility, billing, claim, payment, communication, report, export, or other Dentrix Ascend API action can run while partner and healthcare review is pending.

blocked.label: Clinical, operational, and financial mutations unavailable
blocked.description: Patient or chart changes, appointment creation or updates, prescriptions, treatment plans, imaging, insurance, eligibility, billing, claims, payments, communications, bulk exports, raw PHI, and every mutation remain outside Relay's planned read-only V1 even after approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dentrix Ascend API Exchange review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Practice reads remain unavailable until partner approval, security assessment, SOC 2 Type II and OAuth 2.0 certification, integration testing, exact practice authorization, privacy, and healthcare compliance are accepted.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Henry Schein One approves Relay and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.
No Hermes tools are callable until Henry Schein One approves Relay and Relay implements the approved read-only Railway broker.

providerSetup.blocker: Dentrix Ascend advertises broad APIs only through Henry Schein One's approved API Exchange. Vendors must apply, pass commercial and security assessment, meet SOC 2 Type II and OAuth 2.0 requirements, complete setup and testing, and obtain exact practice authorization. Relay is not an approved vendor and has no private API contract, production OAuth registration, approved organization, BAA and HIPAA allocation, minimum-necessary field map, security acceptance, or production authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Authorized Relay business, legal, privacy, security, healthcare compliance, and product owners must apply to the Henry Schein One API Exchange, accept the commercial and API terms, satisfy its security assessment and SOC 2 Type II and OAuth 2.0 requirements, complete integration testing, and obtain one exact Dentrix Ascend organization's sponsorship and written approval for only the bounded read-only use case. They must document exact endpoints and minimized fields, authorized users and locations, patient consent and purpose limitation, tenancy, audit, retention, deletion, breach duties, limits, disconnect, and production acceptance. Engineering can then implement a fixed-origin Railway OAuth broker for only approved bounded practice-summary reads. Clinical, scheduling, prescription, treatment, imaging, insurance, eligibility, billing, claims, payment, communication, bulk-export, raw-PHI, and every mutation surface remain excluded.

evidence.supports: Dentrix Ascend describes its API Exchange, centralized practice-data access, embedded integration framework, automated multi-location workflows, permission-based data sharing, and approved-partner ecosystem.
Henry Schein One requires vendor contact, security assessment, setup, testing, and active-integration approval, and states integrated vendors are SOC 2 Type II and OAuth 2.0 certified.
Henry Schein One explains that approved vendors can exchange data with Dentrix or Dentrix Ascend and that unauthorized vendors should apply through the API Exchange security process.
Dentrix Ascend describes its cloud scheduling, patient communication, imaging, claims, billing, analytics, multi-location, HIPAA-ready, and SOC 2 Type II capabilities.
